model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates training and validation loss over a series of steps. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.200, with tick marks at 0.05 intervals. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “Training Loss” and begins at approximately 0.190 at step 0, decreasing to 0.045 at step 30, with local minima observed around steps 2 and 8. An orange line, also marked with circular data points, represents “Validation Loss” and begins at approximately 0.080 at step 0, decreasing to 0.025 at step 30, with a local minimum at approximately step 12.
